name: Pomegranate's Bramble
source:
Sleep comes easily, but dreams rarely follow. This night is different. A long-lost friend reaches for you through the haze. You wake clutching a pomegranate...

[From [url=https://jperimeter.itch.io/pomegranatesbramble]Itch.io[/url]]
